text:
incident-bot: :warning: SLO alert: p99 latency above threshold for service/runtime on route /streaming/generate. p99=1200ms (SLO=500ms), p95=320ms. Automated triage attached: increased tail retries and streaming stalls observed.

Alex (oncall): seeing this on the dashboard too. Start time ~1714381950 (about 8m ago). Noticed a jump in cache miss rate for prefix-hash v4.

Priya (eng-sre): linking traces now. p99 spikes correlate with streaming tail stall traces that show KV lookups taking 200-600ms each. Low hit rate on prefix cache: hitrate dropped from 92% -> 18% in last 10m.

Sam (runtime): rolling deploy note: prefix-hash rollout (v3 -> v4) began at 1714381860 from canary -> 40% traffic. Could be a salt change. Pushing logs.

Maya (support): Customer-impact check: top 3 tenants by traffic show elevated request latencies and increased error rate for streaming connections (keepalive resets). Reached one escalation: customer "BrightCart". They reported stalled generator sessions.

Nora (observability): metrics snippet:

```
# prometheus
runtime_prefix_cache_hitrate 0.18
runtime_p95_latency_ms 320
runtime_p99_latency_ms 1200
streaming_active_stalls 142
```

Also saw a surge in prefixcache-invalidation events: invalidation_count spiked at 1714381880.

Alex (oncall): can we confirm if the rollout changed hashing salt or namespace? If so, a mismatch to the hot cache would explain low hits.

Sam (runtime): confirmed. Deploy log: `rollout: prefix-hash=v4; salt=0x4b7a; rollout_percent=40` at 1714381860. Old salt was 0x2f1c. That explains key churn.

Priya (eng-sre): root cause hypothesis: prefix-hash salt change caused majority of cached keys to miss, forcing NV read path and costly recompute, increasing tail latencies and streaming stalls. Secondary: cache warmup hasn't been seeded for v4 so TTL/backfill amplified misses.

Jordan (cust-ops): customers are getting retries and some streaming timeouts; support is fielding chats. We need a mitigation ASAP.

Sam (runtime): mitigation plan options: rollback rollout to v3, or accelerate warmup by backfilling v4 keys via background batch job. Rollback is fastest.

Priya (eng-sre): agree. Rollback to v3 for now to restore hitrate. I'll coordinate rollback. Alex, can you trigger rollback and reduce traffic to canary?

Alex (oncall): doing rollback now. @deploy-bot pausing rollout and promoting salt=0x2f1c -> all traffic.

incident-bot: Deploy event: rollout paused; promoting previous prefix-hash config. user=Alex action=rollback target=prefix-hash v3 timestamp=1714382060

Nora (observability): post-rollback metrics starting to update. Hitrate climbing: 18% -> 68% within 60s. p99 dropping from 1200ms -> 420ms. Streaming stall counts declining.

Maya (support): notifying BrightCart: we applied rollback and will monitor. Asking them to confirm sessions recover.

Jordan (cust-ops): BrightCart confirms generators resumed for a subset of users, some sessions still lagging but improving. Sending follow-up to affected customers with root-cause summary.

Sam (runtime): follow-ups I recommend: 1) add rollout safety check to detect cache-hit shock (block >x% hitrate drop) 2) implement progressive key-warmup job when changing salt 3) update rollout runbook to include warmup or sticky mapping.

Priya (eng-sre): capture for postmortem. Immediate actions taken: rollback at 1714382060, adjust rollout_policy to require traffic ramp step with warmup, created incident bridge.

Alex (oncall): quick checklist for handoff to overnight oncall (tagging next pager):
- Incident start: ~1714381860
- Rollout caused cache key churn -> hitrate collapse -> NV path + streaming stalls
- Actions: rollback prefix-hash to v3 (1714382060), monitor metrics, notify customers
- Remaining items: warmup backfill for v4, add pre-rollout hitrate-canary check, verify no residual faults in consumer clients

Nora (observability): saved dashboard snapshot and attached graph links in thread. Will keep 15m retention trace sample for postmortem.

Maya (support): created support ticket for BrightCart and flagged high priority. Ticket# BC-9012. Keeping customer PMs updated.

Sam (runtime): log extract for timeline:
```
[1714381860] rollout(prefix-hash v4) started -> 40% traffic
[1714381880] cache_invalidation spike detected
[1714381950] p99 > 500ms alert fired
[1714382060] rollback(prefix-hash v3) executed by Alex
```

Priya (eng-sre): I'll own the postmortem and coord with runtime to bake warmup and gating. Sam, please draft the rollout-change PR with canary warmup step.

Sam (runtime): on it. I'll also add an automated query to fail rollouts if hitrate drops > 30% vs baseline within 5m.

Alex (oncall): handing off to Night Pager @Priya for follow-up. Handoff notes in thread. Please ack and take ownership for postmortem coordination.

Priya (eng-sre): ack. I'll pick up and post follow-up tasks after metric stabilization.

Jordan (cust-ops): summary to external stakeholders: outage window ~1714381860-1714382120, impact: elevated p99 and streaming stalls for some customers, mitigation: rollback. Draft sent to execs.

Maya (support): adding final note: tickets opened for affected customers, CS informed. Will update when BrightCart confirms full recovery. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident bridged closed for live mitigation; monitoring continues. Incident severity downgraded to S2.

Priya (eng-sre): postmortem owners: Priya, Sam, Nora. Timeline and action items will be posted in product-postmortems channel by EOD tomorrow.

Alex (oncall): thanks team. Handoff complete.
